verdict.rationale: Trello's REST API reference lists a 'Batch' section, which suggests a first-party way to group many operations into one call. That is a direct but very thin signal, since nothing describes what the batch endpoint does or its limits. 'Automate tasks and workflows' is a generic claim that does not show bulk actions across many cards. Missing for 10: documentation of what Batch covers (reads vs writes, item limits), any UI or automation feature for multi-select or bulk edit/move/archive, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
